title: exotic crispy brazilian potatoes gratin
description: a flavorful and textured gratin dish from brazil, featuring crispy potatoes, steam, and aromatic spices.

ingredients.name: large potatoes
ingredients.notes: any high-starch variety, like russet or idaho

ingredients.name: onion
ingredients.notes: any sweet onion variety, like vidalia or yellow granex

instructions: grease a 9x13-inch baking dish with the olive oil.
slice the potatoes into 1/8-inch thick rounds.
in a large bowl, combine the sliced potatoes, minced onion, grated ginger, cumin, coriander, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
transfer the potato mixture to the prepared baking dish.
cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes.
remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 20-25 minutes, or until the potatoes are golden brown and crispy.
remove the dish from the oven and sprinkle the grated parmesan cheese on top.
return the dish to the oven and bake for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
remove the dish from the oven and let it cool for 5-10 minutes before serving.
